title: The Past, Present and Better Future of Feedback Learning in Large Language Models for Subjective Human Preferences and Values

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review and metadata coding of 95 papers to evaluate the size, demographic diversity, and documentation of the human annotator pools providing feedback to LLMs, revealing a skew toward small groups of US-based, English-speaking young adults.

Reviewing existing literature to document how unrepresentative crowdworker pools introduce downstream political biases into language models, and summarizing methods from surveyed papers that measure it (e.g., using word lists to measure political bias).
Synthesizing findings from related literature to highlight how a lack of demographic diversity in human feedback providers introduces religious biases into model behaviors.
